evidence.title: CSS Loader Library — 99 pure-CSS loaders, free to copy

name: CSS Loader Library
summary: 99 pure-CSS loading spinners you click to copy, each with a ready-made prompt for a coding agent.
description: A library of 99 loading spinners built with pure CSS — no JavaScript, no dependencies. Click any loader to copy its self-contained CSS or grab a prompt that has a coding agent recreate it; every snippet paints with a single --ink colour token and respects prefers-reduced-motion. Part of the Colorion CSS tools collection.
contains: click a loader to copy its CSS or a coding-agent prompt
